decision_logic_review.combinations: At most two disjoint parameter-spec combinations, only after eligible >2% R gain versus current anchor; all fresh and equal exposure.
decision_logic_review.long_shortlist: Always fresh new_control, plus best non-control relative-R candidate, plus best remaining attribute-R candidate.
decision_logic_review.freeze: One non-control recipe frozen against new_control before TRAIN1817/2817; GEN2817/3817 averaged inside each TRAIN first.
decision_logic_review.final_decision: Three TRAIN-start arm means, same seven-metric relative R and gates; no eligible R<1 improvement retains new_control.
decision_logic_review.full50000: Two eval-only seed817 checkpoints, GEN2817, full matched membership; no hyperparameter reselection.

units.coverage_gate: 0.02 fraction = two percentage points, not 2 percent relative
units.attribute_gate: each length/width/speed candidate mean <=1.15 * control mean
units.relative_R: Ratios cancel metric native unit multipliers; mean seven ratios is a custom search score, not a paper metric.

interpretation_limits: No final best exists yet. Prospective CPU branches and smoke configuration are not completed training or evaluation evidence.
4.249 TRAIN epochs forecast plus quick screening cannot prove optimality after 128 native epochs; native full fit reshuffles each epoch while quick long repeats seeded order.
TRAIN817 is adaptive discovery, including long selection. Only fresh TRAIN1817 and2817 are independent post-freeze confirmation (N2); GEN repeats do not increase TRAIN N.
Final R may tolerate up to15% degradation in each attribute while reducing overall seven-metric R; report individual metrics and paired seed results.
Full50000 overlaps validation and audits only discovery TRAIN817; it is not untouched N3 confirmation and does not reselect.
Batch256 matches data exposure but has twice the optimizer/EMA updates and different EMA counter-age; batch effect includes those optimization changes.
optimizer_sd is a bundled AdamW WD/eps/constant-step-schedule alternative; it does not isolate one optimizer subsetting.
Architecture changes (edge/count/sincos) can change common-layer random initialization despite the same seed. Single-seed screening is not a causal isolated claim; finalists receive fresh seeds.
Worker2 pilot state was not bitwise equal, so actual workers remain0; cold/warm timing is not causal speed evidence.
Count limits129/4097 embedding rows cover checked TRAIN8192 and complete50k, not a certified whole TRAIN493542 bound; exceedances raise rather than silently drop samples.
sigma_h is inactive under circular heading source; it was not treated as an effective sweep parameter.

native_smoke_preparation.logger_cli_note: logger=false and logger=null are invalid config-group overrides in this repository; omit top-level logger override, ++trainer.logger=false plus callbacks.learning_rate_monitor=null works; monitor cannot run with disabled Trainer logger.

native_smoke_needed_overrides: Fit: max_steps=1, max_epochs=1, integer limit_train_batches=1, limit_val_batches=0; preserve selected batch/loss/LR/map/normalizer/EMA.

Test: actual selected complete evidence checkpoint from native_best_materialization.evidence_initializer_checkpoint.path, integer limit_test_batches=1, sd_require_full_set=false; preserve matched references and full checkpoint map/G1/buffers/EMA.
Both: devices=1, 32-true, workers0/pin_memoryfalse/persistentfalse and separate output directories.
Fit logging off: ++trainer.logger=false and callbacks.learning_rate_monitor=null; no top-level logger=false/null CLI argument (invalid Hydra group syntax).
Run GPU smoke only after the serialized queue has completed and actual best configs have been materialized; this CPU review did not execute native fit/test.
